describes: packages/plugin/view-manager: panes over the open documents.

cases.name: selectors-before-start
cases.covers: The capability exists from createKernel(); with no panes the selectors are empty, get() and documentView() are null.

cases.name: first-open-makes-a-pane
cases.covers: The effect reconciles whenever the open order changes: the first open (while still loading) creates view-1 and assigns the document to it; later opens land in the focused pane; get/documentView/list read it back as copies.

cases.name: closing-prunes
cases.covers: Closing a document drops it from its pane and picks a neighbour as active; closing every document leaves the empty pane.

cases.name: panes
cases.covers: createView focuses the new pane and later opens land there; removeView refocuses; moveView reorders with clamping and ignores unknown ids; setFocused takes any id.

cases.name: tabs
cases.covers: addDocument/removeDocument/setActiveDocument/moveDocumentWithin/moveDocumentBetween dispatch their actions; the reducer ignores the invalid ones.

cases.name: reordering-tabs-reconciles
cases.covers: documents.move changes the open order, so the effect reconciles (a no-op for pane contents); setActive alone does not.

cases.name: a-failed-open
cases.covers: A document whose open fails keeps its tab in the order (status error), so it stays assigned until it is closed.

cases.name: destroy
cases.covers: After destroy the effect is gone and the capability no longer resolves.
